# BTicino C300X Integration v1.3.1

This maintenance release makes the first setup path clearer for new users and
installs the bundled blueprints into Home Assistant's Blueprint UI.

## Highlights

- Refocuses the README on the guided Quickstart.
- Points new users through HACS install, integration setup, agent setup, Media
  Readiness and the bundled card in the intended order.
- Installs the bundled automation blueprints into Home Assistant's blueprint
  folder when the integration loads.
- Fixes a device-agent diagnostics false warning where an idle, ready RTSP
  bridge was shown as open media resources.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Hard-reload the browser or clear the Home Assistant app/WebView cache if a
  dashboard still shows old card behavior.
